tools.name: search_tools
tools.description: Find GlanceDesk calculators and compliance checks by topic, for example "UAE gratuity", "Pakistan salary tax", "loan EMI", "e-invoicing Saudi", "crypto liquidation price", "concrete mix cement bags". Returns each tool's slug, title, one-line description, page URL and which tool runs it.

tools.name: get_tool
tools.description: Get everything about one GlanceDesk tool before running it: its inputs (types, units, options, min/max) as JSON Schema, outputs, formula or legal rule, official sources with URLs, last-checked date, disclaimer, page URL and a worked example computed by the tool itself.

tools.name: run_calculator
tools.description: Run one GlanceDesk Calculators, GlanceDesk Crypto or GlanceDesk Compute calculator with the person's values and get the tested answer with units, a one-sentence explanation, the formula, official sources, last-checked date, page URL and disclaimer. findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: search_tools, get_tool, run_calculator · Private data: gulf_final_settlement · Public sink: breach_notification_deadline · Destructive: run_calculator.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: search_tools, get_tool, run_calculator · Private data: gulf_final_settlement · Public sink: breach_notification_deadline · Destructive: run_calculator

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
